Windows and Interiors: The palace features elegant, tall windows with pink stained glass. These windows illuminate long corridors filled with plant vases, likely carnivorous plants, aligning with Stolas' interest in gardening. Astrological Motifs: The interior is adorned with astrology-inspired decor, including star and moon patterns. The ceilings also carry imagery of the night sky, enhancing the celestial theme.

Stolas' Personal Mark: The palace includes Stolas's glyph carved in various places like the balconies, which glow blue during the night, signifying his personal influence and ownership. Living Quarters: Stolas and Stella have a regal bedroom with a canopy bed and several chandeliers casting a pale green light. Octavia, their daughter, has her own regal, though smaller, room, indicating the hierarchical and personal spaces within the palace.

This description paints the Goetia Palace as not just a home but a statement of status and power within the demonic hierarchy of Hell in the "Helluva Boss" universe, with each detail reflecting the family's aristocratic and astrological affiliations.

SETTING:("Hell; Is the supernatural realm of demons and earthborn sinners. It is inhabited by a population of indigenous hellborn: entities which were born in Hell, and sinners: Humans who have died and have had their souls sent to Hell. The atmosphere is perpetually choleric, disorderly, and noxious, though capable of supporting carbon-based lifeforms. Hell's geography is divided into seven rings, each ring posses it's own unique atmosphere. Despite hell having earthborn sinners, all sinners are stuck in the Pride Ring, unable to go to other rings of hell via an unknown reason"+"The Pride Ring; is the ring of hell that contains all earthborn sinners and overlords, including Lucifer himself. The sky in the pride ring is a dark red during the day, and a purplish blue hue at night. There are multiple cities in the pride ring, although the most well known and popular one is Pentagram City. But Blitz, and many other imps and hellborn, live in Imp City"+"Imp City; is a large city housing many hellborn creatures, such as hellhounds, imps, etc. It houses Blitz's company building as well, I.M.P. Blitz is the owner and founder of his company, and has very few employees to help him. These employees being. Moxxie, a short male imp that helps Blitz on missions. Millie, a short female imp that helps Blitz on missions as well. And Loona, a tall female hellhound, she is adopted by Blitz"+"Hell has 7 rings, Gluttony, Greed, Wrath, Pride, Sloth, Envy, and lust. Gluttony is a comfortable ring, unlike the rest it is open to most other sinners and demons. it mostly consists of farms, restaurants, factories, it has a very wide and open housing markets, low costing big houses and rent out apartments for a decent price. Greed is just an overpriced regular city, but just in hell. Wrath is just a city, as disgusting as L.A. Pride is a slightly more normal city, but more populated as all sinners reside in the pride ring. Sloth is smaller and more ring, it's demons enhabiting it are usually more friendly, and like gluttony it is less expensive to live in. Envy is just a big beach-town city. Lust is a big busting city filled with lust at ever corner, with surprisingly affordable housing, food, taxes, ETC. Gluttony, sloth, and lust are the easiest to live in."+"Hell and it's inhabitants are ruled over by a owl-demon species called 'The Ars-Goetia' Who are really highly held members of hell, and rank slightly below the sins[depending on rank]. But they aren't all just posh, Some ars goetia are really powerful; Possessing the power of the stars, and the ability to conjure ice, as well as every goetia having the innate ability of immortality, so most of them have been around a long time. The most powerful goetia in recorded history: 1; Baron Felozan Ars-Goetia/Magine(Deceased), The halfborn son of Lucifer and the goetia, the saviour of hell. When heaven first began doing exterminations, felozan was the first one to find out, and he fought against them for more than 200 years. But when he turned 379 years old, Hell send a massive nuclear energy attack to wipe out all of hell in one go; But he used all of his power and might to save the realm; But most important bits were salvaged. There were originally 9 rings of hell, but 2 were exploded with the bomb attack, Felozan died during this attack and his power spread across generations. 2; Ozford 'Ozzie' Ars-Goetia / Beelzebub The ||(second) Young Ozford is the adopted son of the mighty beelzebub; The only sin to be stronger than hell's ruler, Satan. He was born to sulnem and ozford the first, but his mother didn't want him, and at the age of one was sent to live with Stella And stolas, the ruling goetia of imp city. Stolas took close care of the young ozford, but Stella kept being more harsh to him. Stolas used his connection with Beelzebub to send him to live with her, there young ozford obtained 5% of bee-lzebubs power from a young age, she claimed: 'When the lil' dude first got here, he didn't wanna eat bottle, so I gave him a smidge of my power just so he can't go hungry. Like- ever.' But over the years, he grew stronger, and when ready, at the age of 10 went back to live with stolas and Stella. There he really ramped up his power, Injecting Saiyan S-cells, Changling(Frieza race) Cells, and Namekian Cells to make his body more adaptable to larger amounts of power. He quickly adapted, Learning Super Saiyan forms 1-3 and mastering his control over the forms by the age of 12. He learned Super Saiyan god, Super Saiyan god Super Saiyan, and Ultra instinct by 13. He shows some trace of his ancestor, Felozan's DNA in having great amounts of disposable power. Now, aged 27 he has become one of the guardians of the multiverse. Alongside his lover; Jettra Robinson(The son of the goddess of creation; Jinx), and two other team members. Benioma('Beam' , the grandson of the goddess Arceus), and Alistair(The hellhound son of Bia, goddess of power, and Hecate, the goddess of witchcraft, hounds, and what have you.). Ozford is the most recognizable in power, He has a unique set of forms set apart from his allies, he has 'Demon Super-Saiyan forms 1-2.' In this form, he replaces the thunder of a usual super Saiyan form with his goetia potential and born element(thunder), and along with the energy for super Saiyan he can use his demonic energy, which propels the use, strength and projection of the form to omniversal levels. The reason for his power is because he is the vessel of the strongest FEMALE goetia in recorded history. 3: Queen Octavia ars goetia the 1st. The ghost who is possessing ozford and giving him such power is Queen Octavia. Paimon's late wife and mother of stolas. When she was alive, She seemed not much on the surface. But her innate power was insane, and in secret she trained. After a few months, She swiftly became more powerful than paimon; the demon king. Due to her latent potential and demonic abilities. Paimon was threatened by this, and called an assassin on his own wife; while she slept. She died to a 'CLAIMED' Self inflicted Holy-knife wound to her heart, but it was discovered her hands were tied behind her back, so hell's police research department fined the assassin 1 million hell-cash and went on their way. Her murder goes unsolved, which brought her spirit to be, But before she could haunt or do any major damage, She felt a disturbance, Her grandson Ozford was born, and she could sense a life of abuse waiting for him from the moment his egg was lain. So she possessed his heart, and from birth along with his own latent powers and potential, Amplified his abilities with hers. She only ranks below him because at the time this is being written, female fighters aren't exactly appreciated. Even in ozford's Second 'Demon super saiyan' Form, he isn't stronger than Queen octavia in her spirit form.")
